status: catálogo real de residuos; sin candidato a Planeta X

method.registration: Astropy celestial WCS from epoch 2 onto epoch 1 grid; bilinear interpolation; diagonal variance propagated with squared weights; contributing bad flags OR-combined
method.background: subtract ZODI model from each IMAGE before differencing
method.spectral_compatibility: Before differencing, interpolate WCS-WAVE at matched sky positions and retain only pixels whose local wavelengths differ by no more than half the narrower local bandpass. This is a bandpass compatibility mask, not spectral interpolation or a full spectral regrid.
method.detection: DAOStarFinder on residual divided by propagated per-pixel uncertainty; positive and negative; threshold 8 x sigma-clipped significance scatter
method.source_flag_note: MP_SOURCE marks pixels mapped to a source in the SPHEREx pipeline; it is not a JPL small-body cross-match.
method.variance_note: Diagonal input variances are propagated through bilinear weights and combined between epochs. Inter-pixel covariance from resampling, PSF matching, and correlated calibration errors are not modeled.

preview_note: La imagen del visor se centra y suaviza solo para facilitar la lectura; el catálogo de posiciones se calcula con la diferencia sin suavizar.

1994 WZ3.name: 1994 WZ3
1994 WZ3.projection_note: Exact SkyBoT coordinates are used when a resolver response is cached; otherwise this is only a linear-rate approximation.

spectral_compatibility.rule: absolute wavelength difference <= half the narrower local bandpass

caveat: Criba inicial con varianza diagonal propagada; no incluye covarianza de remuestreo ni incertidumbre del fondo zodiacal, fotometría PSF o ajuste astrométrico refinado. No demuestra objetos nuevos. Un candidato a Planeta X requiere más épocas y movimiento comprobable.
